resources.string: Acute blocks known trackers, fingerprinters and cryptominers with Strict tracking protection, connects to websites only over secure HTTPS, and asks sites not to sell or share your data.\n\nIf a site doesn\'t look right, tap the shield in the address bar.
Strict tracking protection, HTTPS-Only mode and Global Privacy Control are on by default. If a site doesn\'t look right, tap the shield in the address bar.
